searchText: mom is alive and everyday we are greatful for that. it’s not easy. can see it’s taking a toll. the new job is amazing. getting a lot of support and getting to sign who i like. just got a top player in the market. got back from dominican sunday, headed to nicaragua next. got to work one on one with aquino last week on his hitting. no joke. they’ve having me doing some scout seminars during st in az. some crazy shit here in detroit with the academy takes up all my free time. we have a meeting with dps next week about going into elementary schools and teaching baseball to classes. i think i’m gonna miss pro scouting. boomer prinstein
